sources.source: Regulator of Social Housing Annual Report and Accounts 2024-25
sources.verified_fact: Published 4 December 2025 for 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025; reports the expanded consumer-regulation role and proactive integrated inspection programme.
sources.quality_effect: Landlords, providers, inspections, findings, standards, regulatory judgments, homes and tenants remain distinct.

sources.source: Housing Ombudsman Annual Report and Accounts 2024-25
sources.verified_fact: Published 16 December 2025; reports service demand and states that 30% more case determinations were issued in 2024/25 than in 2023/24.
sources.quality_effect: Contacts, complaints, cases, determinations, orders, landlords, households and complaint prevalence remain distinct.

sources.source: Housing Ombudsman Data Protection Annual Report 2024-25
sources.verified_fact: The official data-protection page publishes the 2024/25 report and explains that systems and security information was removed or redacted where publication could aid hostile mapping.
sources.quality_effect: Requests, incidents, systems, redactions, security controls, affected records and confirmed breaches remain distinct.

sources.source: Gambling Commission Annual Report and Accounts 2024 to 2025
sources.verified_fact: The official online annual report covers 2024/25 and its financial-statement pages were updated in March 2026 with stated presentation and classification changes.
sources.quality_effect: Operators, licences, consumers, complaints, investigations, sanctions, financial reclassifications and gambling-harm prevalence remain distinct.

sources.source: Electoral Commission Annual Report and Accounts 2024/25
sources.verified_fact: The official report covers the year ended 31 March 2025 and includes performance, accountability and financial statements for the final year of the previous corporate plan.
sources.quality_effect: Elections, contests, parties, campaigners, returns, investigations, sanctions and public-confidence measures remain distinct.

sources.verified_fact: The official corporate-plan page defines multi-year performance measures including publication timeliness, advice timeliness and the audit opinion on annual financial statements.
sources.quality_effect: Targets, measures, baselines, annual observations, statutory deadlines and realised democratic outcomes remain distinct.

sources.source: Bank of England Annual Reports 2026 collection
sources.verified_fact: Published 25 June 2026; the collection separates the Bank, PRA, Asset Purchase Facility, Alternative Liquidity Facility, financial-market-infrastructure, market-operations and climate disclosures.
sources.quality_effect: Institutions, facilities, accounts, supervisory reports, operations and climate disclosures remain distinct document types.

sources.verified_fact: Published 21 May 2026; the collection separates the regulatory system, Commissioner material, candidate guidance, board-member conduct standards and annual data reports.
sources.quality_effect: Codes, guidance, regulated posts, significant appointments, candidates, appointees and data reports remain distinct.
